name: gamez_write_zbd_file
description: GameZ::WriteZBDFile writes the GameZ ZBD header and section offsets, serializes texture/material/display-instance/node sections, drains pending frees, and updates the current ZBD path.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this top-level ZBD writer; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass ZBD/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: The frontier direct callees are zImage::WriteTextureDirectory, zModel_MatlBuffer::WriteGameZ, zModel_DiPool::WriteToStream, zClass_NodeList::ProcessPendingFrees, GameZ_ZBD::WriteNodeTable, and zError::ReportOldNoOp.
The native smoke verifies top-level ZBD file writing, header/section output, pending free processing, and current ZBD path update.
